attribution.note: a serialized subject run owns the meter from its own start until the next subject run's window opens, so its own ingestion tail is attributed to it; the tail is measured, ending at the first silence and capped, and the quiet probe looks only at the region no subject run owns — v3 keeps that window unchanged and only swaps the fixed per-run plausibility ceiling for a rate one
